findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: read_url, link_preview, smart_fetch, price_check · Private data: domain_dns, validate_email, extract_contacts · Public sink: link_preview, detect_techstack, domain_whois, domain_dns, validate_email, seo_audit, extract_contacts, company_enrich, company_enrich_ai, extract_article, summarize_article, ocr_image, screenshot_url, pdf_url, smart_fetch, price_check, domain_authority, traffic_rank, referring_domains, domain_overview, jobs_detect, find_one_job, app_store_details, app_store_review, play_store_details, find_one_place, enrich_one_place, resize_image, convert_image, compress_image, remove_image_background · Destructive: convert_image, remove_image_background.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: read_url, link_preview, smart_fetch, price_check · Private data: domain_dns, validate_email, extract_contacts · Public sink: link_preview, detect_techstack, domain_whois, domain_dns, validate_email, seo_audit, extract_contacts, company_enrich, company_enrich_ai, extract_article, summarize_article, ocr_image, screenshot_url, pdf_url, smart_fetch, price_check, domain_authority, traffic_rank, referring_domains, domain_overview, jobs_detect, find_one_job, app_store_details, app_store_review, play_store_details, find_one_place, enrich_one_place, resize_image, convert_image, compress_image, remove_image_background · Destructive: convert_image, remove_image_background

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
